title: [Feat] - Update Domain Parsing, Enhance Testing, and Refactor Project Structure
body:
This PR brings several improvements and enhancements across multiple areas:

- **Domain Parsing & Validation:**
  - Replaced the legacy `psl` library with `tldts` for domain parsing and validation, which is lighter and avoids deprecated dependencies (`punycode`).

- **DOMMessenger Enhancements & Testing:** (before: `DOMHelper`)
  - Added unit tests for the DOMMessenger methods using a new custom Jest environment (`CustomJSDOMEnvironment`) to better support `innerText` behavior in `jsdom`.
  - Introduced the `jest-environment-jsdom` dependency to support JSDOM testing.
  - Reorganized content scanner imports and renamed `DOMHelper` to `DOMMessenger` for clarity.

- **Code Quality & Linting:**
  - Introduced a new `lint:fix` script in package.json for automatic linting fixes.
  - Integrated `lint-staged` for pre-commit checks and shifted heavy checks to the pre-push hook.
  - Moved `typecheck` and `test` from `pre-commit` to `pre-push` to not discourage frequent commits while keeping the remote safe.

- **Documentation**
  - Added a code style guidelines section to CONTRIBUTING.md. (see `docs/code-style.md`)

- **Observables Implementation:** (before: `ValueListener` / `OrderedSetListener`)
  -  implemented `BaseObservable`, `ObservableValue`, and `ObservableSet` along with corresponding tests.

- **Project Structure & Configuration:**
  - Renamed contentscanner to content-scanner and updated imports accordingly for consistency.
  - Corrected the module path in the Jest configuration.
  - Refactored folder structure and updated ESLint rules for imports.
  - Basic error handling during preferences initialization in Options and Popup components.
  - Removed `package-lock.json` from `.gitignore` for better dependency tracking.
  - *(WIP) Continued refactoring efforts to further improve project structure.*

- Additional smaller fixes/improvents

> **Note:** This PR includes some changes to the general structure that are somewhat subjective. Please feel free to discuss these changes so we can refine them further if needed.

title: [Fix] - producing false positives in results fuzzy search
body:
## What
- Refines the fuzzy search logic in PagesDB to reduce false positives and add ranking. 
- Added tests

## Changes & Notes

**Word-Boundary Matching**
- Ensures “repair” doesn't match “repairs,” “repairable,” or “repaired,” preventing unwanted partial matches.


**matchAllWords Refinement**
- Maintains the existing parameter but improves how it’s applied alongside boundary matching.
- Users can still require all words or allow any single matching word.


**Result Ranking**
- Introduces a ranking mechanism by counting matched words and sorting the results in descending order of relevance.
- Entries are sorted by how many query words they match, surfacing stronger matches first.

## Tests
- Added tests (`database.test.ts`) covering single-word, multi-word, and sorting scenarios
- Restructured the test file by adding `describes` for different parts of `database.ts`

title: feat: Implemented ValueListeners for preferences
body:
With this PR I'm proposing a different way to handle user `Preferences`, in hope to react more easily to their modifications.

Whenever working with them one should call the `Preferences.init()` method to initialize the underling logic that ties the class with the actual localStorage access. Afterwards the developer is free to create custom callbacks that are called whenever the value that such listeners hold changes in any way (do not use the actual value's methods, otherwise callbacks won't fire, use only those defined in the Listener class).
When adding callbacks using `addListener` a string-id is required to recognize different callbacks and to remove them if needed.

Furthermore, excluded domains are now automatically sorted.

I'm open to any feedback, thanks again for your time.
